Fact: data_acquisition
What to find: How training data was obtained and selected, including annotation and synthetic-data generation methods and how rights were obtained.
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data, Data Collection

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: SFT training corpus comprises four sources: (1) publicly available datasets under permissive licenses, (2) internally generated synthetic data targeting reasoning, tool calling, and chain-of-thought capabilities, (3) agentic traces collected across a diverse range of tasks, and (4) a curated selection of human-authored data. Base model pre-trained on a large-scale English and multilingual corpus (details deferred to the Granite 4.1 blog). RL uses verifiable rewards in most environments, with open-ended prompts scored by a generative reward model.
quotes: For all the three, 3B, 8B and 30B models, the training corpus comprises four sources: (1) publicly available datasets under permissive licenses, (2) internally generated synthetic data targeting reasoning, tool calling, and chain-of-thought capabilities, (3) agentic traces collected across a diverse range of tasks, and (4) a curated selection of human-authored data.
which was pre-trained on a large-scale English as well as multilingual corpus.
Most environments provide verifiable rewards, while open-ended prompts are scored by a generative reward model.
